name: record-picker
title: Record Picker
description: Pick records of the kinds the app passes in — search, kind filter, recents, refused rows — in a popover or a dialog.

meta.whenToUse: Linking, relating or inserting records of several kinds: a relation field, a mention target, a block source, a Link to… dialog.
meta.whenNotToUse: A fixed option list (Select, SearchableSelect), people (PeoplePicker) or a place to move something (DestinationPicker).
